idea: Price-target revisions carry information beyond recommendations (Brav and Lehavy 2003): the consensus target relative to its own last quarter. Tests whether the bias-free target result generalises to another consensus source.
rationale_data: mean_estimate_targetprice_annual12_tribes (standardized analyst consensus forecasts, analyst category).
rationale_operators: ts_zscore(63): the target versus its last quarter; rank() normalises across stocks.

idea: Gleason and Lee (2003): innovative revisions, those that move away from the consensus, carry more information and are followed by larger price drift than herding revisions.
rationale_data: anl10_epsinnovation_score_fq2 (performance-weighted analyst estimates, analyst category): innovative increases minus decreases for next-quarter EPS.
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the net innovation score; industry neutralization compares within industries.

idea: Revenue revisions add information beyond earnings revisions (Jegadeesh and Livnat 2006); innovative ones carry the most (Gleason and Lee 2003).
rationale_data: anl10_salinnovation_score_fq1_1702 (performance-weighted analyst estimates, analyst category): innovative increases minus decreases for current-quarter sales.
rationale_operators: rank() normalises the net innovation score.

idea: Earnings forecast revisions (Chan, Jegadeesh and Lakonishok 1996): the consensus annual EPS estimate relative to its own last quarter.
rationale_data: mean_estimate_eps_annual12 (standardized analyst consensus forecasts, analyst category), a vector field aggregated per stock.
rationale_operators: vec_avg() aggregates; ts_zscore(63) compares with the last quarter; rank() normalises.

idea: Disagreement predicts lower returns (Diether, Malloy and Scherbina 2002); here the dispersion of analysts' price targets relative to their mean.
rationale_data: stddev_estimate_targetprice_annual12_tribes and mean_estimate_targetprice_annual12_tribes (standardized analyst consensus forecasts, analyst category).
rationale_operators: the standard deviation over the mean is the coefficient of variation; rank() and the minus sign short high disagreement.

idea: Revenue surprises predict drift beyond earnings surprises (Jegadeesh and Livnat 2006): take the position when a new quarterly revenue surprise is reported and hold it.
rationale_data: mean_surprise_value_fxadj_revenue_quarterly16 (standardized analyst consensus forecasts, analyst category): actual minus consensus quarterly revenue.
rationale_operators: days_from_last_change() == 0 marks the report; trade_when() enters then and holds; rank() normalises.

idea: Accuracy-weighted (smart) estimates revise toward the truth faster than the plain consensus; their recent revision relative to history predicts returns (Chan, Jegadeesh and Lakonishok 1996).
rationale_data: anl10_gpsfq1_smart_ests_v2_2646 (performance-weighted analyst estimates, analyst category): smart estimate of gross profit per share for Q1.
rationale_operators: ts_zscore(63): today versus the last quarter; rank() normalises.
